mapper.insert: INSERT INTO member (login_id, password, email, status, created_at, modified_at) VALUES (#{loginId},#{password},#{email},#{status},#{createdAt},#{modifiedAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE member SET status = #{status}, login_id = CONCAT('deleted_', member_id), email = CONCAT('deleted_',member_id,'@removed.local'), password = '', deleted_at = #{deletedAt}, modified_at = #{modifiedAt} WHERE member_id = #{memberId}
